providerDocumentation: DataV documents GCJ-02 as its primary map-component coordinate system.
coordinateHandling: Provider boundary coordinates retained. No undocumented datum conversion or snapping of dialect outlines to administrative borders.
limitation: The common SVG display projection does not prove that the provider boundary and all city control coordinates have an independently verified common geodetic datum. Registration residuals include source-coordinate uncertainty. Not suitable for precise positioning.
